description: This PHP source file contains the implementation of a web service class (SugarWebServiceImplv4_1) for SuiteCRM, extending base functionality to include relationship handling and synchronization features for the CRM data, such as retrieving related records and modified relationships.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv4_1
classes.description: Implementation class for SuiteCRM web services providing extended methods for relationship retrieval and synchronization, including get_relationships and get_modified_relationships.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related beans and their relationship data for a specified module and record, supporting filtering, ordering, offset, and limit.

methods.name: get_modified_relationships
methods.description: Fetches relationship records modified within a date range, used for synchronization of related records, with options for filtering by deletion status.
